
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Jame-mei/p/19260580" title="发布于 2025-11-23 14:35">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Monit-基于非容器服务自恢复程序实践</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>1.需求：因为历史原因和软件程序原因，有上百台服务和所在服务未运行在容器中，需要在程序奔溃自动拉起(以Java Python C++为主)。</p>
<p>2.目的：能够非人为干预快速自动恢复，要求检测频率在10s一次</p>
<p>3.实现方式</p>
<p>3.1 根据不同语言自己开发脚本实现自动拉起和通知(不够标准化-弃用)</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ContractedBlock.gif" id="code_img_closed_670c8ba3-c544-4172-9529-8f6b87656148" class="code_img_closed"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ExpandedBlockStart.gif" id="code_img_opened_670c8ba3-c544-4172-9529-8f6b87656148" class="code_img_opened" style="display: none">
<div id="cnblogs_code_open_670c8ba3-c544-4172-9529-8f6b87656148" class="cnblogs_code_hide">

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">  5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 确保每个Java服务有对应的启动脚本（如 deploy-xxx.sh）</span>

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>3.2 使用开源通用软件统一维护自动拉起(开发+运维都可以简单维护和使用)　　　　　　　　</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ContractedBlock.gif" id="code_img_closed_c2f7ff69-75b9-4c19-ae7f-9d7b920dc981" class="code_img_closed"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ExpandedBlockStart.gif" id="code_img_opened_c2f7ff69-75b9-4c19-ae7f-9d7b920dc981" class="code_img_opened" style="display: none">
<div id="cnblogs_code_open_c2f7ff69-75b9-4c19-ae7f-9d7b920dc981" class="cnblogs_code_hide">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">程序安装</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> dnf install -y gcc make openssl-devel bison flex zlib-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">devel
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">apt install -y gcc make libssl-dev bison flex zlib1g-dev</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">yum install -y gcc make openssl-devel bison flex zlib-devel</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> wget https://mmonit.com/monit/dist/monit-5.34.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.tar.gz
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> tar xf monit-5.34.0.tar.gz &amp;&amp; cd monit-5.34.0/
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> ./configure --prefix=/usr/local/monit --without-pam &amp;&amp; make &amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> make install
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> mkdir /usr/local/monit/etc -p &amp;&amp; mkdir -p /usr/local/monit/etc/
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> cp monitrc /usr/local/monit/etc/
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> chmod 600 /usr/local/monit/etc/monitrc <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">配置文件定义检测时间，检测配置文件</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> ln -s /usr/local/monit/bin/monit /usr/sbin/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">monit
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> monit --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">version
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> mkdir /etc/monit/conf.d/ -p <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">所有进程检测配置文件，如启动脚本变动修改这里即可</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> cp /usr/local/monit/bin/monit  /usr/bin/
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">systemd配置：vi /etc/systemd/system/monit.service</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[Unit]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> Description=Monit <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">process</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> monitor

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[Service]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span> Type=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">forking
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> ExecStart=/usr/bin/monit -c  /usr/local/monit/etc/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">monitrc
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span> ExecReload=/usr/bin/monit -c /usr/local/monit/etc/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">monitrc reload
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span> ExecStop=/usr/bin/monit  -c  /usr/local/monit/etc/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">monitrc quit
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span> PIDFile=/var/run/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">monit.pid
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span> Restart=on-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">failure 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span> User=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">root
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">31</span> Group=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">root
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">32</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">33</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[Install]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">34</span> WantedBy=multi-user.target  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 多用户模式下开机自启</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">35</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">36</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">systemctl reload monit
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">37</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">systemctl enable monit
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">38</span> systemctl start monit</pre>
</div>
<span class="cnblogs_code_collapse">3.2.1程序安装.sh</span></div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ContractedBlock.gif" id="code_img_closed_533d5f4f-2e70-4fbd-b8b3-54d5f06e2754" class="code_img_closed"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ExpandedBlockStart.gif" id="code_img_opened_533d5f4f-2e70-4fbd-b8b3-54d5f06e2754" class="code_img_opened" style="display: none">
<div id="cnblogs_code_open_533d5f4f-2e70-4fbd-b8b3-54d5f06e2754" class="cnblogs_code_hide">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">进程配置方式vim /usr/local/monit/etc/monitrc：</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> set daemon 10
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> set logfile /var/log/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">monit.log
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 服务配置 /etc/monit/conf.d/rapidtrade-mock.conf</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> check <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">process</span> rapidtrade_mock matching <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rapidtrade-mock</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     start program = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/data/scripts/rapidtrade-mock.sh start</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     stop program = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/data/scripts/rapidtrade-mock.sh stop</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> does not exist then start
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">port配置方式：</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>  check host rapidtrade_mock with address 127.0.0.1
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> failed 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>         port 7040 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        type tcp 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span>         timeout 5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> seconds 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cycles
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    then start
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span>     start program = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/data/scripts/rapidtrade-mock.sh start</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> as uid root and gid root
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span>     stop program = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/data/scripts/rapidtrade-mock.sh stop</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> as uid root and gid root
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> 3 restarts within 5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cycles then timeout
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">健康监测端口+路径:经过测试有问题，无法启动服务并恢复正常。</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span> check host my_web_service with address 127.0.0.1
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> failed

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">32</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        protocol http
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">33</span>         request <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/actuator/prometheus</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 指定要检查的健康检查端点路径</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">34</span>         with timeout 10<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> seconds
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">35</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> 3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cycles
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">36</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    then restart
